title: Old Tainan Magistrate Residence
scope: The standing western-style brick mansion at No. 1 Weimin Street, including two-storey arcades, three west projections, the low later triangular pediment and adjoining rear bays.
limitations: The present restored mansion has the lower triangular third-generation pediment. The original high rounded clock-shaped gable is recorded as historic and is not installed on the contemporary roof.

Native walls and major projections are fixed within the 27-point outline. Opening sequence, cornice profiles, tile color and wall heights are estimated from the 1908 evidence and written current heritage details.
Only the Western residence and its front steps are represented. The vanished Japanese timber counterpart, garden contents, and separately mapped air-raid shelter are excluded.
